home.lead: Film a swing, follow the shooting guide, then queue it for analysis.
home.sub: Use it to review your own practice. This does not promise a higher rating.
home.devNote: This is a development login. WeChat sign-in will be added later.
home.codePlaceholder: Leave blank to use a development code
home.localCode: WeChat did not return a code, so a local development code was used.

guide.title: Shooting guide
guide.intro: Check the items you already did. You can continue if some are open; the job will be marked guide not completed.
guide.incompleteHint: An unfinished guide is stored on this job for a later result.

items.title: Side-on camera
items.desc: Place the phone beside the player so the swing direction is visible. Do not film face-on.

items.title: Full body in frame
items.desc: Keep the head, torso, and feet inside the frame.

items.title: Racket visible
items.desc: Keep the racket in frame through the backswing, contact, and follow-through.

upload.title: Upload a swing
upload.intro: Choose a video or record one. An 8–15 second swing is enough.
upload.guideSkipped: Shooting guide not completed. The upload will still record that.
upload.longClip: This clip is long, so analysis will take longer after it is queued.

queue.title: Queued
queue.guideDone: The shooting guide was completed for this job.
queue.guideSkipped: The shooting guide was not completed. A later result can mark that.
queue.doneHint: A detailed breakdown will be available in a later version. This page does not show scores.
